data.name: Nantu
data.gender_notes: Nantu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Nara-Simha, the man-lion form of Lord Vishnu
data.long_meaning: The name Nantu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' meaning man and 'Simha' meaning lion. This name represents the divine form of Lord Vishnu known as Nara-Simha, who is a man with a lion's head. The name Nantu signifies bravery, power, and strength, and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Nantu carries the meaning “Nara-Simha, the man-lion form of Lord Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nantu usually hope their child will grow to embody nara-simha, the man-lion form of lord vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine union of man and beast, representing the inner strength and courage.
data.etymology: Nantu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nara-Simha, the man-lion form of Lord Vishnu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nantu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
